Inspection as per [1], [2], [3] & [4]. Discharge test (1
hour mini.)
Is the documentation of installed equipment available & complete
Compare the installed equipment to design (e.g. correct fire class)
Is the door safely accessible and free from obstacles
Does the panic door opening work correctly (in the case of an emergency escape door)
Is the door leaf & door frame free from damage and corrosion
Is there anything incorrectly fixed to the door leaf (e.g. screw mounted plates)

Are the door hinges free from damage and corrosion
Clean and lubcricate if it's necessary

Does the door move smoothly without resistance and doesn`t drag on the floor, bang against door frame, or stick at the
rail in case of sliding doors
Are all door & frame sealings ok
Does the door close properly and stay closed
Are the mechanism functioning correctly (handles & lock)
Door handle does not hit the wall when opening
It is possible to lock the door properly
Check pinch protection for damage and correct function
Are there any unusual noises when the door is moving

Verify the functionality of the electronic lock, ensuring proper locking, unlocking, and secure operation as per system
requirements
Is the overhead closer connected & functioning correctly
Carry out a functional cleaning of all relevant components

Check the O&M manual & local requirements (e.g. fire protection concept & building permit) and carry out additional
required tasks
Only central battery station - Is the room properly ventilated
Are the components clean & free from debris -> carry out a functional cleaning if necessary
Visual check of the equipment for damage & missing components (incl.lights & signages)
Identify & secure essential spare parts for reactive maintenance
Are disconnecting devices lockable in the safe position (LOTO)
Test all safety relevant switches for correct function
Are the circuit diagrams and relevant technical documentation available and complete
Are there manual entries in the drawings or technical documentation that indicate changes to the installation

Carry out a flick test - simulate a power outage & check the system for correct function (ensure all emergency lighting
turn on or stay illuminated)
Only for em. lights with local batteries - Check for alarms at the light/signage

Perform thermographic scans of the electrical cabinet and central battery system
-> Create a WO for over-temperature to determine the root cause immediately

Add a detailed note for all over-temperature measurements -> list the location and temperature -> Upload the
thermographic scans

Is the air filter & grid of the cooling inlets clean
-> clean or change filter if necessary
Are the cooling fans operating appropriately and doesn`t make any unusual noise
Are there any alarms indicated -> if yes identify the root cause immediately
Has a circuit breaker tripped -> if yes identify the root cause immediately
Visual check of cable connections -> e.g., pinched insulation in the contact area
Visual check for the protection against direct contact with live parts
Have any obvious changes been made (e.g. rewiring, hanging cables)
Are all components properly labeled or marked
Are all metal parts connected to the protection earth (ground)
Is the ground connection to the building ground as designed?
Ensure all cable connections are correctly torqued according to manufacturers specification

Only central battery station - Measure the voltage of each battery (disconnected) -> if necessary, plan for a
replacement

Only central battery station -Measure the charging voltage and current before & after functional test
-> Compare to design specification & plan component exchange in case of an issue
Only central battery station - Check the internal uninterruptable power supply of the unit for correct function
Only central battery station - Check the batteries for leakage or damage
Only central battery station - Check the fluid level of the batteries and top up if required
Carry out a functional cleaning if required
Check the O&M manual and carry out additional required tasks
